ledger: Single continuous shot, ~10 s, no cuts or time skips; camera slowly pushes in and arcs from a front three-quarter view of the car to a close profile of the woman.

Space 1 (exterior): flat desert with scrub and distant purple mountains; a two-lane road with yellow center dashes runs along the car's left side; utility poles and a sign appear along the road as the camera arcs (00:04.5-00:09.75). Car sits on the gravel/dirt shoulder. Consistent across the shot.

Space 2 (car interior): cream station wagon with woodgrain sides, roof rack, near-side (driver-side) mirror, front door and rear side windows; seats/headrest and steering-wheel area visible through windshield and side windows.
Opening A, windshield: from outside it shows the dashboard, rear-view mirror, seats and the desert through the far-side glass (00:00-00:03); consistent with the established exterior.
Opening B, near-side front door window: shows dark interior seats (00:00-00:03) and green upholstered seat directly beside the woman (00:07-00:09.75); consistent with the interior.

Woman (denim jacket, arms crossed, resting on the hood): her torso sits at the base of the windshield, just inboard of the near-side mirror, from 00:00 to 00:09.75. Directly below her is the near-side front fender, front wheel and woodgrain panel, so there is no floor or standing space where her legs could be.
No traversals: nobody moves between spaces; the woman stays in the same place on the car the whole time.
Functional arrangement: no furniture. The car fixtures (mirror, wipers, antenna, hood ornament) are in plausible positions.

findings.description: The woman's torso comes up out of the cowl, between the windshield's lower edge and the near-side A-pillar/mirror, with her crossed arms resting on the hood. She is not standing beside the car: the near-side front fender, front wheel and woodgrain panel are fully visible directly below her (00:00-00:03), so her lower body would have to be inside the fender or engine bay. She is not leaning out of the door window either, since the window is behind the mirror and she is in front of it. She is not behind the car leaning across: she is on the near edge of the hood, and the windshield and interior are visible behind her. From 00:07 to 00:09.75 the interior seat shows through the side glass directly beside her shoulder, which confirms she sits at the A-pillar inside the car's outline. No off-screen space can explain this position.
